products.title: LocalPlaces Understanding Soweto Tour
products.description:
This is simply the best tour of Soweto, guided by the famous LocalPlaces - Johannesburg Chief Storyteller & Guide, Charlie Moyo. It will provide you with a thorough understanding of Soweto, as well as the history and legacy of apartheid. 

Anyone visiting Joburg must certainly visit Soweto at least once. The Southwestern Township has a legendary reputation for the way its people resisted apartheid, especially during the 1976 Youth Uprising. Today Soweto is a mesmerizing, inspiring and somewhat thriving part of Joburg, but still overcoming the all-to-clear legacy of Apartheid. 

This tour takes in the captivating Hector Pieterson Museum, Vilakazi Street where two Nobel Peace Prize winners once lived, the Mandela House Museum, the Regina Mundi Church and Orlando Towers, among others.

While this tour deals with the overwhelming, shocking, and somewhat dispiriting struggle against the injustices of Apartheid, it also leaves you inspired by what the people of Soweto has overcome.

products.title: Orlando to Miami Day Trip by Train with Bus Tour & Boat Cruise
products.description:
Your day begins at the Orlando Brightline station, where you will board a high-speed train heading south. Departing from Orlando Airport, the train takes you directly to the heart of Downtown Miami. 

Upon arrival, a short walk leads to Bayside Marketplace Mall, where you’ll embark on a scenic Biscayne Bay cruise with breathtaking views of the city skyline, luxurious waterfront mansions, and iconic landmarks, including the celebrity homes of Star Island. 

In the afternoon, choose between riding an open-top bus for a narrated city tour through Miami’s highlights, such as Wynwood’s street art and the vibrant Cuban culture of Little Havana, or taking a boat taxi to South Beach for a relaxing experience. Stroll the sandy shores, explore Ocean Drive, or enjoy local flavors at beachfront restaurants.

Let us arrange the tickets you need to have a great independent day out. In the early evening, board the train back to Orlando and enjoy the stress-free convenience of this unforgettable trip.

products.title: Zombie Scavengers Game - Lakeland, FL
products.description:
Zombie Scavengers tests your ability to survive after a Zombie Apocalypse. The game leads you through the city, where you will have 60 minutes to collect survival items for your colony.
The Setting:
Small colonies of the living are doing all they can to survive. You and your team have been tasked with scavenging for survival supplies for your colony. You’ll only have 60 minutes to figure out which items you'll need and find as many items on the list as you can. 
Your Mission: 
With 1 hour and your team of up to 10 people, you will use your smartphone to search the area for much needed food, supplies, and shelter. Along the way, you will be asked to do some challenges or answer some trivia questions. The goal is to score at least 4000 points in 1 hour in order to survive the zombie apocalypse!

LED neon edge-lighting means you can play day or night, making it one of the only late-night mini golf experiences in Orlando. No theme park admission required: just walk up to CityWalk and grab a "single feature" (18 holes) or "double feature" (36 holes) like you're picking a movie at the box office.

products.title: Fun Gnocchi Cooking Class With a Local Chef in Orlando
products.description: Chef Nylah brings a deep passion for culinary arts and an Associate Degree in Culinary Management to the table. This gnocchi-making class in Orlando offers an enjoyable, hands-on experience in a lively brewery setting known for its craft beers and welcoming atmosphere. In this class, Chef Nylah will guide you through making fresh gnocchi dough from mashed potatoes, flour, salt, and egg. You'll then knead, cut, and shape the dough into perfect gnocchi pillows. Additionally, you'll prepare a rich tomato sauce with olive oil, butter, garlic, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, mozzarella cheese, and basil. The class concludes with combining the gnocchi and sauce for a delightful Italian feast.

This hands-on adventure not only teaches young horse lovers about caring for these magnificent animals but also ensures a fresh theme and exciting activities each month. The well-trained, happy horses eagerly carry their riders, creating a safe a relaxed experienced while you enjoy the sites of the trail and the new partnership of your horse.

products.title: Orlando Theme Park Loop
products.description:
Orlando is a different city from 1,000 feet.

You lift off Kissimmee Gateway and the sprawl resolves into something you can finally take in — the theme park district laid out below you, resort towers catching the light, the chain of lakes running to the horizon. Most people go quiet for the first minute.

This is genuinely private. No shared cabin, no strangers, no waiting for a group to fill. Just your party, your pilot, and a four-seat Cessna where every seat is a window seat.

Your pilot is a certified instructor who flies this airspace daily. Over the headset, they'll talk you through the landmarks, the airspace, and what the controllers are saying. Ask questions — most people do.

About 30 minutes in the air, an hour at the airport start to finish. No experience needed, no age minimum, no security lines. You'll land with a phone full of photos nobody else in your group has.

products.title: Manatee River Run Curated Slingshot Adventure
products.description: Explore the unique charm of Old Florida on a self-guided Slingshot ride along the Manatee River Run. This 4-hour adventure kicks off in Kissimmee and takes you to breathtaking waterfront views at Titusville, where the Kennedy Space Center provides a stunning backdrop. The highlight of your journey is a stop at the Haulover Canal, a prime spot for observing wild manatees in their natural habitat. The serene landscapes of Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge enhance your experience with the chance to spot dolphins and other marine wildlife.

products.title: Holiday Scavenger Hunt in Lakeland by Holly Jolly Hunt
products.description: Holly Jolly Hunt is a scavenger hunt that is played using an app on your smartphone, that brings your entire family and friends together for holiday cheer. During the adventure you’ll be seeking out all the traditional, and even the non-traditional holiday items we all see this time of year around the city. You’ll get points for each item you find. products.title: Peacocks, Presidents and Puzzles - The Winter Park Walking Tour
products.description:
Welcome to one of Florida’s best-kept secrets, the lovely city of Winter Park!

Chartered in 1887, Winter Park is more than 100 years old and has the pedigree to prove it. Home of the first college in Florida, host to multiple U.S. Presidents swapping the chills of Washington for a tropical paradise, and the southern magnet of many celebrity visitors, Winter Park has a rich history just waiting to be explored and discovered!

Whether you are a visitor or a seasoned Central Floridian, you encounter intriguing tales of the past, savor the present, and envision the future as we guide you through the incredible brick-lined streets of Winter Park!

products.title: Mt. Dora Canal Boat Tours with Lunch
products.description:
If you’re looking for one of the most scenic boating experiences in central Florida, the Dora Canal belongs at the top of your bucket list. Tucked between Lake Dora and Lake Eustis, this breathtaking waterway has been called “The Most Beautiful Mile of waterway in the world.” Lined with towering cypress trees draped in Spanish moss, teeming with wildlife, and rich in Old Florida charm, the Dora Canal is a must-visit for kayakers and paddleboarders seeking a peaceful, nature-filled adventure.

On this trip we will take you through the Dora canal into the town of Mount Dora where you can have a little bit of the Key West feel going through craft shops and local restaurants.

The Dora Canal isn’t just a natural wonder—it’s a historic passage that once served as a key transportation route for steamboats traveling through Central Florida. In the late 1800s and early 1900s.

products.title: Fun Pasta Making Class With a Local Chef in Orlando
products.description:
Fresh pasta night hits differently when the pasta is actually handmade by you. In this interactive cooking class with Chef Ny, hosted at a stylish local venue in Orlando, you’ll learn how to make authentic fettuccine from scratch while enjoying a cozy, social and beginner-friendly culinary experience.

The class starts with crafting pasta dough using flour, olive oil, eggs and sea salt before learning proper kneading and shaping techniques for smooth, tender fettuccine. While the pasta cooks, Chef Ny will guide you through building a flavorful marinara sauce with tomatoes, garlic, basil, red pepper and Parmesan that smells straight out of a classic Italian kitchen. Every step is designed to feel approachable and fun, whether you cook regularly or consider boiling water a major accomplishment. By the end of class, you’ll plate a comforting homemade pasta dish and leave with practical techniques that make recreating fresh Italian dinners at home surprisingly doable.
